summary: Brand Engagement Network Inc. filed an 8-K regarding a letter agreement with HighTide Energy, Inc. (Accelevate Solutions) for a proposed strategic investment and commercial collaboration. The company expects to invest up to $1,000,000, with an initial $250,000 payment and a second $750,000 installment upon definitive agreements. The transaction is for equity interests in Accelevate at an $8,000,000 pre-money valuation, with warrant coverage, a reseller arrangement, and a board seat for the investor. The terms are non-binding, subject to due diligence and definitive agreements, with binding provisions on confidentiality and exclusivity. Watch for execution of definitive agreements and completion of due diligence.
